reel.title: Year 4 trip to the Science Museum

scenes.title: The trip
scenes.caption: Year 4 visits the Science Museum.
scenes.say: Year 4 is off to the Science Museum on Friday the eleventh of December. Here's what parents need to know.

scenes.title: The day
scenes.caption: Be in class by 8.30am. Back about 3.45pm.
scenes.say: Children must be in class by half past eight, as the coach leaves at quarter to nine. Collect them from the main hall about quarter to four.

scenes.title: The cost
scenes.caption: £14.50 a child, paid on ParentPay.
scenes.say: The trip costs fourteen pounds fifty a child. Please pay on ParentPay by Friday the twenty seventh of November.

scenes.title: Free meals
scenes.caption: Free school meals: the trip is free.
scenes.say: If you get free school meals, the trip is free, and the school will give your child a packed lunch.

moves.cue: give your child a packed lunch

scenes.title: What to bring
scenes.caption: Packed lunch, coat, uniform. No money or phones.
scenes.say: Bring a packed lunch with no glass bottles or nuts, a waterproof coat, and school uniform. No money, phones or toys.

scenes.title: Helpers, medicine
scenes.caption: Helpers and medicine: tell school by 27 November.
scenes.say: They need four parent helpers with a school DBS check. Tell the class teacher. Medicine must be in school, labelled with your child's name.

scenes.title: Consent slip
scenes.caption: No consent slip on ParentPay, no trip.
scenes.say: Last thing. Fill in the consent slip on ParentPay. Without it, your child cannot go. For any questions, ask the school.

faults: scene 3: the pay move shows no banknote or coins in the final picture; Reelie is shown but says nothing and just crowds the school, and the clock badge floats beside the price without saying what it is for
scene 4: the packed lunch is a plate with a label too long for its spot, and it sits touching the school; the parcel sent to the child is not a lunch; the heart does not show the trip being free
scene 5: the compare card shows a phone and a briefcase-like bag, so it does not show a packed lunch, a coat or uniform, and toys and money are not shown; the picture is unclear without reading
scene 6: the helpers icon is a pair of people, not four; medicine is a pill with no child's name, and 'Tell the class teacher' is not shown
scene 7: the tick on the school appears at 'Without it', when the slip has not been sent, so it says the opposite of the words; the label 'Consent slip' is too long and crowds its neighbours
